verdict.rationale: Warehouse Sync documents pulling data from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks into mParticle via an API, SQL reference and data mapping. Audiences can then be connected to downstream outputs for activation, so warehouse tables can feed activation. However, Warehouse Sync ingests (copies) the data into mParticle rather than modeling it in place, and 'Composable Audiences' appears only as a bare title with no detail on building audiences directly on warehouse tables. Missing for 10: evidence of zero-copy audience and model definition on warehouse tables, detail on Composable Audiences, independent or hands-on corroboration.
